name: Sequential Prophet 12
description: Sequential Prophet 12 (DSI), layers A and B, every program and global parameter in its Operation Manual's NRPN tables.

sources.title: Prophet 12 Operation Manual (version 1.0)
sources.notes: NRPN tables read by tools/profiles/sequential/read-nrpn-tables.mjs from Prophet_12_Operation_Manual_v.1.0.pdf, pages 72-74-92 (sha256 d2125e5f1140162c7d30ffd27b160da5415f4c4789f9bebd3ffa04b60322477c), https://sequential.com/downloads/prophet_12/doc/Prophet_12_Operation_Manual_v.1.0.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/sequential/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/sequential/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN tables, on its number, with its printed range and name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Values go out as the manual prints the format: NRPN MSB/LSB on CC 99/98, value MSB/LSB on CC 6/38. The instrument must have its Global MIDI parameter receive set to NRPN (or All).
1 parameter(s) the manual marks as transmitted but ignored when received are read-only.
NRPN 288 is printed as "A/B Mode" (program) and as "BPM" (program); the first is used

Left out, printed without a range: NRPN 480 (Name Character 1), 481 (Name Character 2), 482 (Name Character 3), 483 (Name Character 4), 484 (Name Character 5), 485 (Name Character 6), 486 (Name Character 7), 487 (Name Character 8), 488 (Name Character 9), 489 (Name Character 10), 490 (Name Character 11), 491 (Name Character 12), 492 (Name Character 13), 493 (Name Character 14), 494 (Name Character 15), 495 (Name Character 16), 496 (Name Character 17), 497 (Name Character 18), 498 (Name Character 19), 499 (Name Character 20).
